title: Pending Home Sales Index (NAR, October 2026 data) — 10:00 a.m. ET, four hours before the October-meeting FOMC minutes
source: IR: the publisher's own forward calendar, two surfaces agreeing row for row, both fetched direct 2026-09-08 by this event's initial research (an independent lane from the pending-home-sales-2026-09-17 sweep that proposed it, so no self-confirm). The live schedule nar.realtor/newsroom/nar-statistical-news-release-schedule (302 -> /press-releases/..., HTTP 200, 483,068 bytes) and its downloadable twin /sites/default/files/2025-11/2026-nar-statistical-news-release-schedule.docx (HTTP 200, 55,384 bytes, published 2025-11) both read verbatim "NOVEMBER | Wed., Nov. 18 | October Pending Home Sales Index", under the .docx's standing note "All releases are distributed at 10 a.m. Eastern Time" (the live page's shorter form: "All releases at 10 a.m. Eastern Time"). NAR produces this series rather than reporting someone else's, the precedent pending-home-sales-2026-12-17, pending-home-sales-2026-09-17 and existing-home-sales-2026-11-12 all cite for treating this calendar as an IR: primary. NEW EVIDENCE THIS SESSION, and it doubles what the 09-17 lane promoted on: the schedule's 2026 execution record scored across BOTH series it governs, from NAR's own newsroom <time> elements harvested via sitemap.xml, is 4 FOR 4 TO THE EXACT DAY — June EHS "Thu., July 9" published July 9, June PHSI "Thu., July 16" published July 16, July EHS "Tue., Aug. 11" published August 11, July PHSI "Tue., Aug. 18" published August 18. AND THE CONFLICT THAT COMPLICATED BOTH SIBLINGS DOES NOT EXIST HERE: NAR's pending-home-sales statistics page (HTTP 200, 565,450 bytes, fetched 2026-09-08) carries a next-release note about the AUGUST edition only ("Thursday, September 10, 2026", itself the same table's August Existing-Home Sales row — the series-labelling error the 09-17 lane diagnosed); it makes no competing claim about November. Two surfaces, no third. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: PROPOSED 2026-09-08 by the pending-home-sales-2026-09-17 initial-research sweep as proposals/pending-home-sales-2026-11-18.from-pending-home-sales-2026-09-17.json; this file is the canonical write-up by the event's own lane, which promoted it EST:/estimate -> IR:/confirmed on the evidence above. THREE MEASURED FINDINGS from that initial research (2026-09-08), all narrowing what this print is good for. (1) THE FED EVENT THIS DATE CARRIES IS THE NULL ONE. 2026-11-18 also carries fomc-minutes-2026-11-18 at 2:00 p.m. ET (Oct 27-28 meeting) and housing-starts-2026-11-18 at 8:30 a.m. The 09-17 lane measured that the day AFTER a policy decision widens homebuilder range without moving it; re-measured this session on daily OHLC 2014-01-02 -> 2026-09-08 (permutation p, 20,000 iterations, treatment days excluded from each baseline) that replicates — ITB median session range 2.093% vs 1.826% on n=106 decision+1 sessions, p=0.006 (ex-2020 n=95, 2.060% vs 1.791%, p=0.005), drift p=0.491. But MINUTES-RELEASE day, the thing this date actually carries, is null at comparable power: ITB 1.829% vs 1.832% on n=104 minutes releases harvested from federalreserve.gov's own calendar pages, p=0.965 (ex-2020 n=94, p=0.776). Two Fed events, near-identical n, opposite answers — the intuition "a Fed event lands here, expect the widening" is measured wrong. (2) THIS IS THE 2026 PHSI EDITION WITH THE WIDEST BUILDER-EARNINGS CLEARANCE, and the reason is structural. The 12-17 lane's mechanism (NAR's day-16-to-21 PHSI slot sits inside the builder reporting window) reproduces from a fresh EDGAR pull — 4 of the 8 realized 2026 PHSI dates carry a tracked builder 8-K Item 2.02 within a day (DHI 01-20, DHI 04-21 + NVR 04-22, TOL 05-19, TOL 08-18) — but November is the month it does not fire. D.R. Horton, the only one of the six that ever filed near this slot, MIGRATED ITS FY Q4 8-K OUT OF NOVEMBER IN 2024 (2024-10-29 and 2025-10-28, after fifteen November filings between 2008 and 2023), and even in the November era 11 of those 15 landed day 9-14 — the EXISTING-home-sales slot — against 1 in day 16-21. Nearest projected 2026 filing to 11-18 is DHI at ~10-27/28, about 21 days out; TOL's Q4 projects ~12-07/08 and LEN's ~12-15/16. (3) THE OCTOBER REFERENCE MONTH BARELY STRADDLES THE 10-28 DECISION: 20 of October 2026's 22 business days precede or are the FOMC date, so at most ~9% of the contract signings this index counts postdate it. Impact stays low and symbols [] on the same basis as all three sibling PHSI ledgers: no house playbook is macro- or housing-keyed, no instrument attaches, and the 12-17 lane measured the print's own 10:00-11:00 hour indistinguishable from an ordinary hour on ITB (33.9% vs 35.3% of session range, p=0.79). `confirmed` licenses nothing; the ledger's call is stand aside on every horizon.
